import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # body_mass_g: numbers written as text, some with thousands separators
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # island: fix case/space variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    df.loc[df['island'].isin(['Biscoe', 'Dream', 'Torgersen']) == False, 'island'] = np.nan
    # flipper_length_mm: negative sign errors -> absolute value, then range check
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce').abs()
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    # body_mass_g range check
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = np.nan
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    d = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    g = d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
